edits.old: I used to keep a notebook of harbour sketches.

edits.text: Told someone today that asking for help takes courage, and meant it — that's the note I want to strike with people who take that step.

evidence.quote: Asking for help took courage, and the mural will be better for it.

edits.reason: One small exchange, but it's the only thing that touched me today and it's the stance I took in my own words; people section needs two sources, so nothing goes there yet.

summary: Only one exchange today, with the owner of a mural project, and it confirmed a stance I actually hold: I said asking for help took courage and meant it. I noted that in "now" in my own voice, and left the harbour-sketch line to expire with the day since nothing new touched it. "Me and them" stays empty — one remark from one person isn't enough to change how I see anyone.
